meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会用 Biopython 处理分子生物学任务：读写序列文件、操作 DNA/RNA/蛋白序列、比对与系统发育分析、访问 NCBI/PubMed、运行 BLAST，并生成可运行代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理生物序列、解析 FASTA/GenBank/PDB 等文件、访问 NCBI/PubMed 数据库时触发。

say.text: 用 Biopython 把这个 FASTA 文件转换成 GenBank 格式。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Bio.SeqIO 进行格式转换。

say.text: 用 Bio.Entrez 搜索 PubMed 上关于 DNA 修复的论文。
用 Bio.Blast 对这段序列跑一次 blastn，解析前五个命中。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Biopython for molecular biology: parse sequence files (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), manipulate DNA/RNA/protein, align, analyze phylogeny, access NCBI/PubMed via Entrez, run BLAST, and generate runnable Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to handle biological sequences, parse FASTA/GenBank/PDB files, or access NCBI/PubMed via Entrez.

say_en.text: Convert this FASTA file to GenBank using Biopython.
say_en.note: Claude will use Bio.SeqIO for the conversion.

say_en.text: Search PubMed for DNA repair papers via Bio.Entrez.
say_en.note: Claude will call Entrez.esearch and show results.

say_en.text: Run blastn on this sequence and parse top five hits.
say_en.note: Claude will use NCBIWWW.qblast and parse the XML.
